verdict.rationale: Pulumi publishes an official MCP server. The docs say it gives AI assistants access to query Pulumi Cloud stacks and resources, search cloud resources, generate infrastructure code and optionally delegate tasks to Neo. It is documented as working with Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf and Claude Desktop, and a probe confirms the official MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in real use.
